title: Number of Essential Services Companies Allowed to Operate during COVID-19 Circuit Breaker Period
what_it_is: Number of Essential Services Companies Allowed to Operate during COVID-19 Circuit Breaker Period

sections.label: Workforce on-site during circuit break
sections.summary: During the enhanced circuit break from 21 April 2020, 17% of the total workforce continued operating on-site at about 45,000 entities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Under the enhanced circuit break period starting 21 April 2020, 17% of our total workforce continued operating on-site at approximately 45,000 entities.

sections.label: Global supply chain productions continue
sections.summary: Productions in the global supply chain, including petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals and certain manufacturing parts, also continue to function.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: At the same time, all the productions that are part of the global supply chain, including petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals and certain parts of manufacturing also continue to function.

sections.label: Reopening economy and global supply chains
sections.summary: As the economy progressively reopens, Singapore looks to reinforce its position to fulfil responsibilities to global supply chains such as pharmaceuticals, biomedical, electronics or petrochemicals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: As we progressively reopen our economy, we are also looking to reinforce our position to fulfil our responsibilities to the global supply chains, be it pharmaceuticals, biomedical, electronics or petrochemicals.

sections.label: Social entertainment firms rethink business model
sections.summary: Companies in social entertainment and those requiring high worker-customer or customer-customer interaction need to rethink their business model to restart operations safely.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: For example, those companies that are involved in social entertainment, as well as those companies that require high level of interactions between the workers and the customers or amongst the customers, will also need to rethink their business model in order for us to restart those operations safely.

sections.label: Essential services minimum operations instructions
sections.summary: MTI instructions to essential services aim to reduce numbers to the minimum while maintaining required essential services, and essential firms do not get 100% of workers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: And why is it that there appears to be companies in the same industry that do not get the same instructions from MTI, in essential services?

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: So, we try to reduce the numbers to the minimum possible, while maintaining the level of essential services required by our local community.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: For essential firms, we will first want to make sure that they have a minimum level of operations that can continue to do so.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: So, even for essential firms, it does not mean that all essential firms get 100% of all the workers that they need.

sections.label: Prioritising aggregated versus standalone operations
sections.summary: Companies providing aggregated services with minimum staff are prioritised, while standalone operations needing disproportionate staff are advised to restructure, pare down or temporarily suspend.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: So, all else being equal, for those companies that provide a series of services in an aggregated manner with a minimum number of staff required, we will be able to prioritise them and help them to continue their operations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: But on the other hand, companies that have standalone operations and require perhaps a disproportionate amount of staff, we will advise them to restructure their operations to pare down their numbers or, if not, to temporarily suspend their operations for the moment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Having said that, of course, this is an on-going process.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: We work with all the essential firms and companies to size up the demand for their workforce.
